title: Integrated cosmological memory: A dark-siren method to probe dark energy
summary: Gravitational-wave (GW) cosmology is currently bottlenecked by the scarcity of electromagnetic counterparts for bright sirens and the systematic uncertainties of galaxy catalogs for dark sirens. We propose a purely gravitational resolution using the Integrated Cosmological Memory (ICM)-the cumulative GW strain encoded in the spacetime geometry of an expanding Universe. While the GW transient emitted by the source provides the luminosity distance, the ICM accumulates a mathematically distinct integral of the cosmic expansion history.
